text:
alex: Heads-up — nightly microbench on candidate kernel 'kX_v2' (avx512 path) showed a regression at seqlen=4096. Throughput ~18% lower vs baseline. Putting logs here for quick triage.

maria: ugh, 18% is annoying. Do we know if this is KV-cache related or the attention kernel itself?

alex: initial profile points at increased memcpy/transpose time in the KV path during chunked caching. Not the attention math itself.

samir: can you paste the run command + a few lines of output? that helps reproduce locally.

alex: sure — here's the invocation we run nightly: 
```
./kbench_runner --model gpt-4-slim --kernel kX_v2 --arch avx512 --seqlen 4096 --batch 1 --iters 500 --autotune off
```
And trimmed stdout (p99 tail):
```
[2026-04-28 03:12:10] RUN kX_v2 avx512 seqlen=4096 batch=1 iters=500
[2026-04-28 03:12:57] tokens/s: 1520 (baseline 1850)
[2026-04-28 03:12:57] cpu memcpy  ms/op: 0.42 -> 1.1
[2026-04-28 03:12:57] kv-cache transpose ms/op: 0.23 -> 0.9
```

maria: memcpy 0.42 -> 1.1 sounds like a vectorized path got deoptimized. Could be a fallback code path triggered by alignment or tile size.

samir: Is this only for long seqlen? any regression at 1024/2048?

alex: smoke checks: 1024/2048 are within 3% of baseline. The spike starts >3072.

jin: CI side — the nightly job posted a failing alert: <https://ci.internal.redwood/kbench/1719987654|kbench#1719987654> (summary attached). It flagged regression >10% so it blocked candidate promotion.

ci-bot: [build 1719987654] kbench-nightly: FAILED — throughput regression detected (18.1%). See artifacts: https://artifacts.internal.redwood/kbench/1719987654

maria: proposal: add a sequence-length gate in the selector rules: for seqlen > 3072, prefer kX_v1 (stable) for avx512 until we root-cause. We should also add a microprobe that reproduces the memcpy/transpose hotpath in isolation.

samir: agree. Also add an autotuner sweep that tries different tile sizes and alignment fixes (try tile=64,128 and prefetch tweaks). Might be a kernel codegen issue on kernel v2.

alex: I'll create a short repro microprobe and throw it into /bench/microprobes/kv-transpose-64x.json and link it into nightly. For now can we add a temporary picklist entry: 
{"arch": "avx512", "seqlen_min": 3073, "prefer": "kX_v1"}

jin: I can push a quick config patch to gate kX_v2 for long seqlen in perf CI. Do you want that hotfix today?

alex: yes please — hotfix the picklist, and I'll iterate on the probe + perf profile. After repro we can attempt a codegen tweak and run the autotune.

maria: also add a note to the candidate checklist: "verify KV transpose latency at seqlen >= 4096 on avx512". We slipped on that one.

samir: one more idea — add a lightweight in-Runtime assertion that logs when memcpy time > 0.8ms for a single op at seqlen>3072 so we can catch it in debug runs. cheap and useful.

alex: +1. I'll follow up with a PR for the probe and the runtime assertion.

ci-bot: patch queued: https://phabricator.internal.redwood/D12345 (picklist hotfix). Nightly should re-run at 04:00 UTC.

jin: thanks — I'll monitor the rerun and unmute the candidate gate if things look stable.

alex: action items: (1) jin pushes picklist hotfix (today) (2) alex adds microprobe + profile dump (today) (3) samir runs autotune sweep on tile/prefetch (tomorrow) (4) maria updates candidate checklist (today).

maria: thanks all :thumbsup:

samir: ping me when the probe is in, I'll start the sweep.

alex: done for now, will update thread with links to artifacts once uploaded.
